description: Fixed, reviewable data policy for the one-shot Codex review runner. The runner may start the locally installed Codex CLI exactly once, for one already-validated pending relay request, read-only, with a prompt it builds itself. It accepts no caller prose, no model choice, no extra directory, no approval or sandbox override, and no retry. A verdict is an opinion: PASS means only that a second reader found no objection, and it grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution. Every value below is fixed; a policy that disagrees is refused. Pure data: no regular expression, no command line, no environment value, no machine path, and no credential.

codex_cli.prompt_delivery_note: Proven from local `codex exec --help` on 0.153.0: the PROMPT argument states that if it is not provided as an argument, or if `-` is used, instructions are read from stdin. The explicit `-` form is used so the argument array shows the intent and the prompt never appears on a command line.

npm_package.name: @openai/codex
npm_package.layout_note: Read out of the installed launcher, not invented. `npm i -g @openai/codex` writes only shims -- `codex` (a `#!/bin/sh` script), `codex.cmd`, and `codex.ps1` -- and none of them is an executable image; each merely re-execs `node <prefix>/node_modules/@openai/codex/bin/codex.js`. That launcher computes a Rust target triple from platform and architecture, resolves the matching optional dependency, and spawns `<platform package>/vendor/<triple>/bin/codex(.exe)` directly. Windows cannot start an extension-less `#!/bin/sh` file, so the runner reproduces the same resolution with the shim as a locator only, and starts the identical native binary with no shell, no cmd.exe, and no Node in between. The published platform packages carry the scope name `@openai/codex` rather than their directory name, and pin the build in the version as `<version>-<os>-<cpu>`; both are checked.

environment_note: Only these names are forwarded, and only when already present in the parent. CODEX_HOME is included because `--ignore-user-config` still resolves authentication through CODEX_HOME. No API key, broker credential, Anthropic variable, trading flag, or unlisted parent variable is ever passed to the child, and no value is ever printed.
non_authorization_sentence: This verdict grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution.

reviewer_session.note: The reviewer is registered by a person before the run and closed by a person after it. The runner only reads the record; it never registers, pauses, resumes, closes, or advances a session.
